title: Rav Ila
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Menachot 81a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.81a.4): “Rav Ila fell ill; Abaye and the Rabbis went in to visit him.” Shitah Mekubbetzet reads “Rav Ila bar Abba,” but Hyman considers the Dikdukei Soferim reading more correct: “Rav Ulla”; so too in the Venice printings of רפ״ט and ש״ח.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: I Chronicles names Ilai the Ahohite. Hyman uses this for comparison with the name Ila.

The linked Bavli reads Rav Ila. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2885&lang=en) cites the same visit and suggests Rabbi Ilai as a possible reading. Hyman prefers Rav Ulla and reports Rav Ila bar Abba from Shitah Mekubbetzet.
The Venice dates רפ״ט and ש״ח correspond to 1528/29 and 1547/48. The readings of those printings are Hyman’s report.
